infer_pedestal_positions: infer pedestal positions from a warehouse mocap trajectory by averaging prop positions over initial timesteps
get_props_z_extent: get the z-extent of all props in a warehouse trajectory at the current physics timestep
segment_interval: get the start and end time bounds for a named clip segment like APPROACH or PICKUP in a segmented trajectory
get_random_timestep_in_segment: get a random timestep from a specific clip segment using a provided random number generator
generate_segments: automatically segment a single prop carry trajectory into approach, pickup, carry, putdown, and backoff phases
